name: Workpro Quantum 9000 Series Ergonomic Mid-Back Mesh/Mesh Chair, Red/Black
description: Tackling your daily calendar while seated in this WorkPro task chair means you have the cushioned comfort and adjustable features you need to stay active and efficient until the day is done. Add in the stylish looks, and this ergonomic mesh office chair turns into a great option for just about any home or office. Overall dimensions of the Quantum mesh chair: 43-3/4"H x 29-1/2"W x 28"D. Weight capacity tested to support 275 lb. Adjustable lumbar cushioning supports your lower back and enhances the natural curve of your spine. Waterfall seat cushion slopes slightly downward to help reduce stress on your legs. Seat cushion glides forward or backward to best suit the length of your legs. Mesh fabric breathes to keep you cool and looks good, too. Steel frame construction ensures durability. Effortless 1-touch seat-height adjustment. Change the tilt with the touch of a finger. Synchro tilt reclines the backrest at a 2:1 ratio to the seat, increasing the angle between your torso and thighs for a comfortable, ergonomic sitting position. Adjustable tilt angle moves both the seat and backrest at the same ratio, letting you rock or recline in comfort. You can also adjust the angle of the back cushion and the seat. Ergonomic office chair utilizes height-/width-adjustable armrests with unique gel padding to help relieve shoulder strain. Dual-wheel casters for easy mobility. Meets or exceeds ANSI/BIFMA Performance Standards. Assembly required. Instructions are included. Backed by the manufacturer's 10-year limited warranty. Task chair with a black frame and red fabric complements virtually any existing office décor.
